additional_info.subject: 0405888 - ID0405888-DC/Si-D/DE-[Y2 / S7 313757457010] Failsafe mode active CRM:00643001282
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0405888 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s) :
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
Maybe
Onsite Troubleshooting
Yes
End Customer Communication
Yes
Spare Part Ordering
Maybe
Performance monitoring by RC
After analyzing the logs, we found that there is no communication between the SECC and the PLC, which is causing it to enter fail-safe mode. We need to align for the site intervention, and please check the following:
Check the Ethernet cables and ensure all cables are properly tightened.
Check the 24V supply to the SECC, and verify that the EcoG has lights on it.
Try replacing components if nothing else helps.
Since we are getting a KF12 error flag, it indicates that the PLC is unable to reach KF12.
Please bring a couple of Ethernet cables and an EcoG unit as well.
MLFB : 8EM5903-0AA00-6AA1 (KF11) & 8EM5903-0AA00-5AA6 (KF12)
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue, or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline on ISP.
Later assign the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2) Team
, using "
Assign
" function and then move the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
using "
Add to Queue
".
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Shrey Sharma

replying
to it.
